craft_evidence.owned: no: Acushnet FY2019 and FY2025 10-Ks say that for KJUS apparel "we source the finished products" from third-party vendors; no KJUS facility in the Manufacturing section
craft_evidence.makers: none on the 37 product pages read 2026-10-11 (no factory or maker named)
craft_evidence.mills: Loro Piana: named as fabric source ("Loro Piana wool/cashmere fabric made in Italy") on 2 of 37 pages read, both Orange Label jackets (Verbier Luxe K01125, Cashmere Tech K01132); grid tile names also show Loro Piana on a sale Lombardi Coat and a wool cap; Toray Dermizax membrane named (licensed tech, not a mill claim)
craft_evidence.madein: 0 of 37 product pages read state the garment country of origin (2 state fabric origin, Italy, for Loro Piana cloth); 37 = 17% of 215 men's clothing styles, ski and lifestyle only
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed, but inconsistent: brand story places the start in the mid-1990s idea and an early office in an old train station in Oslo; brand FAQ (live, 2026-10-11) says originally founded in Switzerland, HQ now Boulder, Colorado; press (FashionNetwork, 2019) gives 2000, founders Lasse Kjus and Didi Serena, HQ Hünenberg
craft_evidence.process: partial: the Tech Guide describes fabric treatments and constructions (sealed seams, stretch panels, hollow-core Pima yarn, graphene fabric); no making process (factories, sewing, finishing) described
craft_evidence.reasoning: KJUS owns no production: Acushnet's 10-K says KJUS finished goods are sourced from third-party vendors. On the 37 product pages read in the 2026-10-11 retry no garment states a country of origin and no maker is named; two Orange Label jackets name Loro Piana cloth made in Italy. That is a named mill on a sliver of the range and nothing else checkable, so 2 stands (not 3, which needs makers or mills named across the range).

ownership.owner: Acushnet Holdings Corp. (NYSE: GOLF); acquired July 2019, price undisclosed (Acushnet FY2019 10-K); KJUS sits under Other, outside the three reportable segments (FY2025 10-K)
